method: Totals and metadata from the GitHub REST API (gh api repos/<repo>) on the snapshot date; growth windows (this week, 30 days, today) from github.com/trending?since=weekly|monthly|daily on the same date. The stargazers endpoint returned 404 in this environment, so star history was NOT reconstructed independently; growth figures are as reported by the Trending pages and are not the live GitHub rate.
selection_criteria: listed on GitHub Trending (week and/or month)

claims_from_authors: original skill about 450 lines on one repo
one run found roughly half of the vulnerabilities that repeated runs found in total (README)
caveats: needs OS-enforced sandbox for target-controlled builds/tests
audit only code you are authorised to test

claims_from_authors: 62 deterministic detector rules, no LLM or API key
caveats: installed command hooks run even if the model's own commands are denied (README)
anonymous telemetry; opt-out via npx impeccable telemetry off, DO_NOT_TRACK=1 or config
live mode edits a local checkout only

claims_from_authors: ~10x token savings from the 3-layer search workflow (README estimate)
search results ~50-100 tokens each; full observations ~500-1,000 tokens each
caveats: installer may offer a browser sign-in with a 30 day trial for the hosted observer; skip with an explicit --provider or CLAUDE_MEM_ONLINE_OPTIN=false
hooks record tool-usage observations; review what is stored and use <private> tags

weekly_trending_snapshot_rank_note: security-audit-skill had the largest weekly gain among the repos listed on the weekly Trending page fetched on the snapshot date.
not_selected_note: Several other fast-growing repositories were skipped because their owner, licence or README did not meet the selection criteria above or the claims could not be checked in time; no judgement about them is implied.

licensing.note: No third-party screenshots or logos are redistributed; only short paraphrases and command lines from the READMEs.

narration_disclosure: Narration is a local synthetic voice (VoiceStudio Narrator 03) and the presenter avatar is AI-generated.
derived_note: Piecewise rates are arithmetic on two Trending windows (7 and 30 days); they assume the windows are rolling and are labelled as derived on screen. Per-day curves between the three points are straight lines, not daily data.
